title: Label-free quantitative proteomic analysis of adult Drosophila heads
author: Zhang, Nezis

steps.title: Calculate and load 200 µg protein
steps.instruction: Determine the volume needed to obtain 200 µg of extracted protein based on its concentration, then mix this amount with UA buffer in a Millipore filter tube (UFC500396) so that the total volume equals 400 µL.

steps.title: Wash filter with UA buffer (3×)
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the filter unit at 12 000 g for 20 min at 4 °C and discard the flow‑through. Add 400 µL UA buffer, centrifuge again at 12 000 g for 20 min at 4 °C, discard flow‑through, and repeat the add‑and‑centrifuge step two more times (total three washes).

steps.title: Reduce and alkylate proteins
steps.instruction: Add 300 µL UA buffer containing 6 µL of 1 M DTT to the filter tube, mix and incubate at 37 °C for 1 h. Then add 30 µL of 1 M IAA buffer, mix and incubate in the dark at 25 °C for 1 h (ensure the filter tube is cooled to 25 °C before adding IAA).

steps.title: Wash filter with UA buffer (2×) after reduction
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 12 000 g for 20 min at 4 °C, discard flow‑through, add 400 µL UA buffer, centrifuge again at 12 000 g for 20 min at 4 °C, discard flow‑through, and repeat once more (total two washes).

steps.title: Wash filter with ABC buffer (2×)
steps.instruction: Add 400 µL ABC buffer, centrifuge at 12 000 g for 20 min at 4 °C, discard flow‑through, and repeat the add‑and‑centrifuge step once more (total two washes).

steps.title: Digest proteins with trypsin
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL ABC buffer containing trypsin at an enzyme‑to‑protein ratio of 1:50, seal the filter tube lid with sealing film, and incubate at 37 °C for 20 h (use a fresh collection tube before adding trypsin).

steps.title: Collect and dry tryptic peptides
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the filter units at 12 000 g for 20 min at 4 °C, add 200 µL ABC buffer, centrifuge again at 12 000 g for 20 min at 4 °C, collect the flow‑through containing tryptic peptides, evaporate to dryness in a Labconco SpeedVac for 3–4 h, then store at –20 °C (pause point: samples may be stored up to 1 month at –80 °C).

steps.title: Prepare LC‑MS/MS system
steps.instruction: Perform monthly and batch‑start MS/MS calibration, install fresh mobile solvents A and B, install the pre‑column and analytical column, flush pumps A, B, and S with mobile phase (flush threshold 10 µL), equilibrate both columns with solvent A, run a blank to check performance, and optionally run QC standard mixtures.

steps.title: Prepare peptide samples for injection
steps.instruction: Dissolve dried tryptic peptides in 200 µL 0.1 % formic acid (solvent A), centrifuge at 12 000 g for 20 min at 4 °C, transfer the supernatant to a new Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Load samples onto nano‑LC and run gradient
steps.instruction: Inject 10 µL of the peptide solution onto an Ultimate 3000 RSLCnano HPLC using an Acclaim PepMap μ‑precolumn (C18, 5 µm, 100 Å, 300 µm × 5 mm) and an analytical Acclaim PepMap RSLC column (C18, 2 µm, 100 Å, 75 µm × 50 cm). Use the following LC gradient (flow 300 nL/min): 0‑2 min 0 % B, 2‑5 min 0 % B, 5‑8 min 3 % B, 8‑25 min 13 % B, 25‑30 min 25 % B, 30‑32 min 32 % B, 32‑35 min 90 % B, 35‑40 min 90 % B, 40‑45 min 0 % B. LC parameters: injection volume 10 µL, column temperature 40 °C, sampler temperature 6 °C, max pressure 480 bar.

steps.title: Set mass spectrometer acquisition parameters
steps.instruction: Use a Nano Spray ionization source at 2.1 kV. Acquire full MS scans from 375–1575 m/z at 120 000 resolution with AGC target 2 × 10⁵ and max injection time 150 ms. For MS/MS, set isolation window 1.2 Th (Orbitrap Fusion) or 2.2 m/z (Q‑Exactive), HCD collision energy 33 % (Orbitrap Fusion) or 27 % (Q‑Exactive), MS2 AGC target 5 × 10³, max injection time 200 ms, select precursors with charge 2–7, dynamic exclusion 50 s with 10 ppm tolerance, first mass 120 m/z, enable monoisotopic precursor selection and run in top‑speed mode.

steps.title: Analyze raw data with MaxQuant
steps.instruction: Open MaxQuant v1.6.5.0, load all raw files (step 1), generate the experimentalDesignTemplate (step 2), assign experiment numbers (step 3) and read the template (step 4). In Group‑specific parameters, set type to “Standard” and Multiplicity = 1 for label‑free quantification (step 5). Set precursor tolerance 4.5 ppm and product tolerance 15 ppm (steps 6, 10). Allow up to two missed cleavages, fixed modification carbamidomethyl (C), variable modification oxidation (M) (step 7). Enable LFQ with minimum ratio count = 2 (step 8). In Global parameters, add the Drosophila proteome FASTA file (step 9). Set minimum peptide length = 7 and FDR = 1 % for peptide and protein (step 11). Perform three to four biological replicates for each genotype.

steps.title: Identify accumulated proteins
steps.instruction: Locate result files in the “…\combined\txt” folder. Open “ProteinGroups” in Excel, remove reverse and contaminant entries, keep only protein groups with at least one unique peptide, calculate the average LFQ intensity for each protein in each genotype, compute the ratio (Atg8a or Atg8a‑LDS ÷ wild‑type), perform a two‑sample Student’s t‑test, and consider proteins significant if p < 0.05 and fold change > 2.
